verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents an n8n sandbox or test environment that is isolated from production data. The source-control page appears only as the title "Push and pull changes" (its URL mentions environments, but no quoted text describes isolated environments), and Git version control is a different feature. Self-hosting extra instances would be a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
